args.title: Enable Export Button After Failed Export
args.body: Issue 4192 reports that if an export fails (for example, if the server returns an error), the Export button stays greyed out, preventing further attempts until the page is reloaded. The proposed change in the file src/export/ExportButton.ts will ensure that the Export button re-enables itself after a failed export attempt, allowing the user to click and try the export again without needing to reload the page.
